# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive, assume good intent, and keep
discussions about the work. Harassment, insults, discriminatory language and
publishing other people's private information are not accepted.

Report unacceptable behaviour to the maintainer,
[@GAWI01](https://github.com/GAWI01), through a private message or, for
security-sensitive matters, as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Reports
are handled confidentially. The maintainer may remove comments, close issues or
block participants who break these rules.
